pages: Tiare, a girl of ten, black hair in two plaits, a scarlet wool coat with the hood down, opens one hardback log with a green cover on the observing desk. Middle distance: ruled columns along the top of the sheet, a red lamp, a chair. Background: the dome shutter open on a wide field of stars. Red lamplight.

Tiare, a girl of ten, black hair in two plaits, a scarlet wool coat with the hood down, sits at the desk with a pencil held just above one open green log, the ruled sheet below the headings left blank. Middle distance: the red lamp turned low, the telescope. Background: the open shutter, dense stars. Red lamplight, ink blue.

Tiare, a girl of ten, black hair in two plaits, a scarlet wool coat with the hood down, stands beside one round white wall clock, pencil in hand, her eyes on its hands. Middle distance: a black radio set, the open green log, the red lamp. Background: the dome shutter and a thick field of stars. Low red lamplight.

Tiare, a girl of ten, black hair in two plaits, a scarlet wool coat with the hood down, writes with a pencil into one open green hardback log, her face down over the ruled sheet. Middle distance: the red lamp, a rolled star chart, the telescope. Background: the open shutter, the milky band across the sky. Red lamplight.

Tiare, a girl of ten, black hair in two plaits, a scarlet wool coat with the hood down, leans over the observing desk writing in one open green hardback log under a low red lamp. Middle distance: the telescope, a folded chart, the wall clock. Background: the open shutter, cloudless stars. Deep ink blue, low red light.

Tiare, a girl of ten, black hair in two plaits, a scarlet wool coat with the hood down, comes up the dome stairs and writes into one open green hardback log, filling ruled lines. Middle distance: the red lamp, a pushed-back chair, the wall clock. Background: the open shutter, dark sky. Red lamplight on her hands.

Tiare, a girl of ten, black hair in two plaits, a scarlet wool coat with the hood down, looks down at one open green hardback log, both hands flat on the desk. Middle distance: a pencil, the red lamp, the desk edge. Background: the dome shutter and the night behind it. Low red lamplight.

Tiare, a girl of ten, black hair in two plaits, a scarlet wool coat with the hood down, stands at the desk with one sheet of ruled graph paper under her palm. Middle distance: the green log, the red lamp, a stack of charts. Background: the dome shutter open on the stars. Red lamplight, ink blue night.

Tiare, a girl of ten, black hair in two plaits, a scarlet wool coat with the hood down, strikes one line diagonally across the blank rows of an open green hardback log, pencil in her hand. Middle distance: the red lamp, a straight edge, the ruled columns above. Background: the dome shutter, hard stars. Low red lamplight.

Tiare, a girl of ten, black hair in two plaits, a scarlet wool coat with the hood down, writes a fresh column in one big bound book, the green log beside it. Middle distance: the red lamp, a sheet of graph paper, the wall clock. Background: the open shutter, hard stars, frost on the rail. Red lamplight.

Tiare, a girl of ten, black hair in two plaits, a scarlet wool coat with the hood down, stands with one finger resting on a ruled line of the open green log. Middle distance: a sheet of graph paper, the red lamp, the wall clock, a pencil. Background: the dome shutter and the night. Low red lamplight on her hands.

Tiare, a girl of ten, black hair in two plaits, a scarlet wool coat with the hood down, puts one green hardback log onto a shelf of old ledgers. Middle distance: the shelf of worn books, the dome stairs, a hanging scarf. Background: the white dome above with its shutter shut, stars. Starlight, a little red lamp.
